name: trim
description: Long shell output, folded before Claude reads it. Errors, the start and the end stay; you see about how many tokens that saved.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Switch trim off without uninstalling it. The modmyclaude hub flips this too.

lines.title: Fold past this many lines
lines.description: Output this long or longer (or past the character limit) is folded. 40 to 100000.

chars.title: Fold past this many characters
chars.description: Output this long or longer (or past the line limit) is folded. 1000 to 10000000.

keep.title: Always keep lines matching
keep.description: A pattern (a regular expression, case-insensitive; use | between several) whose lines are never folded. Leave empty for none.
